newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Astra says unaware Investor cutting stake.
newsitem.headline: Astra says unaware Investor cutting stake.

text.p: Drugs company Astra on Thursday repeated that the company was not aware that investment company Investor AB was reducing its stake in the company as rumoured in the financial markets on Thursday.
Astra spoksman Staffan Ternby said the company did not recognise anything of the like.
"We don't know anything about this. We assume this is a false rumour that is spreading to affect the share price," Ternby told Reuters.
Ternby also denied a rumour that management from Swiss rival Roche was in Stockholm today for a meeting with Astra.
"There has not been any contact between Roche and Astra," he said.
Ternby said another rumour going around is that a major owner in Roche has changed its shares for some of Investor's Astra shares ahead of a possible bid by Roche for Astra.
"There seems to be no limit to people's imaginations", Ternby said.
Astra's share price hit a new high of 339 crowns in morning trade in Stockholm and at 1230 GMT was trading 8.5 crowns higher at 336 crowns.
